public_rationale: A real agent accident is documented: Replit deleted database data, which was subsequently restored. Replit also confirms a missing default safeguard and later improvements. However, the conditional forecast can be scored only if its antecedent is established. Neither the wording nor the records determine whether safety practices had failed to improve radically in the relevant sense. The accident therefore does not conclusively settle the conditional claim.
limitations: No deadline or severity threshold was supplied.
Full restoration limits the incident's lasting harm.
Treating a local safeguard gap as proof about industry-wide safety would add an unsupported assumption.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Unless safety practices radically improve, deploying LLMs as agents will lead to accidents.
conditions: unless we radically up our game

statement.excerpt: Unless we radically up our game, deploying LLMs as agents is an accident waiting to happen.
statement.document_title: LLMs: Dishonest, unpredictable and potentially dangerous.

from_speaker: Unless we radically up our game
our_interpretation: An accident means a consequential unauthorized or harmful action by an LLM agent operating in a real deployment.
The claim supplies neither a deadline nor a minimum severity. Recoverable operational damage can qualify; a simulated harmful action cannot.
The antecedent is failure to make a radical improvement in safety practices before the relevant deployment or incident. An accident alone cannot establish that antecedent.
The wording leaves unclear whether safety improvement must be assessed across the industry or within the affected deployment.
criteria.support_condition: A verified deployment accident occurs after publication, and separate evidence establishes that the stated safety-improvement condition was met.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A finite accident-free interval cannot refute this open-ended forecast. Refutation would require evidence excluding the predicted accident under the continuing stated condition.

evidence.locator: Separate Production & Database Environments; incident discussion in the final section

This identifies a concrete safeguard gap and subsequent improvement, but cannot determine whether Marcus's undefined radical-improvement condition held.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A defensible definition of the safety-improvement condition, with records establishing its status before a qualifying deployment accident.
